jobs.title: Detention Facility Officer: Security, Care & Reports
jobs.description: City of Rowlett, TX is seeking a Detention Officer to perform detention, intake, and release of inmates under supervision in the City detention facility. You will log property, conduct bookings, fingerprint and photograph inmates, and perform related reports and data entry. Responsibilities include monitoring inmate care, serving meals, providing minor medical attention, and ensuring security with locking and alarm systems.
